question: What effect on age and death follows from abstaining from food by day?
premises: Non-eating by day is prescribed as a means
Age and death are mentioned together
inference: Through abstaining from food by day, one will overcome death associated with aging.
uncertainties: gamiṣyate with mṛtyuṃ is ambiguous; may mean go beyond or approach death
plain_english: By abstaining from food during the day, one will go beyond death due to age.
